explication: FluxDO is a Flutter client for the Linux.do community. The principal workflow is browsing community content and using forum features—searching, posting, replying, and receiving notifications—with saved content, media, and rendering capabilities supporting that experience. The README describes the Flutter architecture and Rust DoH proxy, but the supplied source excerpts mainly cover native WebView plugins and Android channels; app-level call relationships therefore cannot be verified here. Documented links use README evidence, and platform-channel links use the sampled MainActivity reference list.
